---
title: 'A <i class="x">formatted</i> <B>bold</B> <i title="a>b">gt</i> <abbr>abbr</abbr> <i-custom>cu</i-custom> title with $x^2$'
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
citation: true
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_title"][content="A formatted bold gt abbr cu title with $x^2$"]']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-appendix-citeas', '.quarto-appendix-bibtex']
        matches: ['Formatted']
        noMatches: ['abbr>', '</i', 'i-custom', 'textless']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<em>Formatted</em>', '\\emph\{Formatted\}', '\\textbf\{Bold\}', '\\emph\{Gt\}']
---

Raw HTML inline tags that CSL supports keep their formatting; other tags keep only their text.
